decisions.statement: A reading naming no slug reaches every inference service.
A slug no page is filed under is refused by name.
A page that will not load refuses rather than reading as no service.
A page missing a value a service needs refuses rather than reading as a service.
One page that refuses refuses the whole reading.
The folder handed to the host is the folder the named script sits in.
A page naming a script no page is filed under is refused by name.

definition: the inference service a page states, read from the index and the page
